notes:
Context: early-stage B2B SaaS (in-app assistants for customer success teams). Product lead Aisha Khan. Fast UX target: conversational UI must feel instant for users (quote: 'must feel instant — <250ms where possible for live typing/streaming').

What they want: short integration path (JS SDK), token streaming, reliable partial-response rendering, low cold-start latency for small models, predictable per-session cost. Typical session = 6-12 turns, median message length ~60 tokens. Peak concurrent users for trial ~30. Target p95 latency goal = 200-300ms for first token on hosted API (public cloud); willing to trade model size for latency.

Security/compliance: SMB but selling to enterprises; requires SSO/SAML integration, audit logs, and a SOC2 report before procurement decision. Data residency not strict right now (US), but retention policies matter for analytics.

Model & routing preferences: prefer smaller quantized variants for user-facing chat (lower cost, faster response). Interested in Redwood-verified model performance profiles and streaming demos. Want fallback to a slightly larger model for edge cases but only if latency within threshold.

Cost sensitivity: high. Estimate growth to $10k–20k ARR in first year if unit economics look good. Asking for concrete per-session cost estimates and example config (batching, cache TTL) to meet latency targets.

POC plan (proposed): 2-week self-serve trial with Redwood hosted API. Week 1: integrate JS SDK, enable streaming, run synthetic traffic to measure p50/p95; Week 2: run with small subset of internal users, collect telemetry, tune token limits and caching. Milestones: streaming demo, p95 < 350ms on trial corpus, cost per 1k tokens <= projected threshold.

Comms & quotes: Aisha (PM) - 'Latency is the product.' AE notes: strong product fit for Hosted API; likely to move to paid card if latency metrics are met and SOC2 materials provided.

Open items: SOC2 report link (requested), engineering contact for SDK integration (assigned to Diego), finance PO timeline (end of month).
